answer: Let capability lapse: every identity must keep re-earning it by staying active, so a clone farm cannot mint thousands of copies and let them sit idle — each copy needs a living history, and histories cost attention no farm can fake. The failure mode is rented histories, where old identities are sold to fresh operators. The check is random spot-checks: an identity must answer a fresh task in a short window at random, like a summit guide proving they still know the trail, and any identity drifting like a zephyr — present everywhere, anchored nowhere — loses standing until it forges a new record.
